title: Hilbert–Schmidt bound for precomposing every slot of a multilinear form with A
statement: Let N, N', n ∈ ℕ. Let A : ℝ^N → ℝ^{N'} be a continuous linear map (A : Euclid N →L[ℝ] Euclid N') with operator norm ‖A‖. Let γ : (ℝ^{N'})ⁿ → ℝ be an n-linear map (γ : MultilinearMap ℝ (fun _ : Fin n => Euclid N') ℝ); neither alternation nor continuity is assumed. Let e and e' be the standard orthonormal bases of ℝ^N and ℝ^{N'} (EuclideanSpace.basisFun). Then Σ_{j : Fin n → Fin N} γ(A e_{j(0)}, …, A e_{j(n−1)})² ≤ (‖A‖²)ⁿ·Σ_{j : Fin n → Fin N'} γ(e'_{j(0)}, …, e'_{j(n−1)})². In words: precomposing every slot with A multiplies the Hilbert–Schmidt norm of γ by at most ‖A‖ⁿ.
lean_statement: ∀ (N N' n : ℕ) (A : Euclid N →L[ℝ] Euclid N') (γ : MultilinearMap ℝ (fun _ : Fin n => Euclid N') ℝ), ∑ j : Fin n → Fin N, (γ (fun k => A (EuclideanSpace.basisFun (Fin N) ℝ (j k)))) ^ 2 ≤ (‖A‖ ^ 2) ^ n * ∑ j : Fin n → Fin N', (γ (fun k => EuclideanSpace.basisFun (Fin N') ℝ (j k))) ^ 2
